notes: Head of s001 changed from *manner* to *this*: the *manner of* frame is supplied, and rule 99's six corpus units head such a frame on the pronominal or demonstrative word and none on *manner*, rule 104 requiring the demonstrative member of the paradigm to be analysed like the interrogative. The competing head on *manner* is recorded in the unit's note.

σήμερον → *this day* at 6:11 is not the same case and keeps its head on *day*: there the Greek word carries a day-element for *day* to gloss, so rule 66's compound-core arm decides it, whereas οὕτως carries no manner-element at all.
The vocative Πάτερ is anarthrous and takes no supplied address word here, so rule 89 does not bear; the following article keeps the relativizer under rule 31's verbless-modifier clause.
